create_blip_tokenizer: create a BlipTokenizer from pretrained model and tokenize text with [DEC] and [ENC] special tokens
create_blip2_tokenizer: create a Blip2Tokenizer from pretrained model and tokenize text with [DEC] bos token
create_ofa_tokenizer: create an OFATokenizer from pretrained model with code tokens and bin tokens for image binning
create_full_tokenizer: create a FullTokenizer from a vocab file and tokenize text using basic and wordpiece tokenization
convert_tokens_to_string: convert a list of wordpiece tokens back to a cleaned string using FullTokenizer
